description: List every Carragent AI agent: what it does, when it runs, what waits for the owner's approval, what it never does and which tools (Stripe, Google Calendar, HubSpot…) it connects to. Use it when a user asks what Carragent can do or wants to compare the agents. Returns { agents: [...] }, one object per agent with its id for get_agent.

lang.description: Language of the text: en, es or fr.

area.description: The family it belongs to: money, customers, sales or operations.

tools.description: The tools it connects to, or null when there is nothing to connect.
